name: r3a1-mcp-text-channel-carries-addresses
description: R3a-1 Outcome 2 (KV-A02a/02b) MCP content channel: the text channel of knowvault_search and knowvault_list_objects must carry the canonical evidence addresses and page cursor exposed by structuredContent, so a client that reads only content[].text can locate and read each result. internal/platform/workspaceapi/mcp_search.go mcpSearchHitLine writes each structured canonical_address directly into the search text line; mcpContentAddress is only the compatibility fallback when no canonical address exists. Replacing the active builder.WriteString(canonical) call with an empty write leaves the header, per-hit metadata and page cursor intact while dropping each canonical locator. TestMCPContentTextCarriesSearchHitsAndCursor asserts that every structured canonical_address parses and appears in content[].text, so it kills the mutant.
baseline_meaning: On the unmutated tree mcpSearchHitLine renders every structured canonical_address verbatim into content[].text, together with the fragment id, excerpt, score, version and offset/limit/has_more/next_offset cursor, so TestMCPContentTextCarriesSearchHitsAndCursor passes over the MCP tools/call path. The legacy address JSON remains only as a tested fallback when canonical_address is unavailable.
mutant_meaning: With builder.WriteString(canonical) replaced by an empty write, the canonical_address label, per-hit metadata and cursor still render, but the locator value is absent. TestMCPContentTextCarriesSearchHitsAndCursor fails because content[].text no longer contains the parseable canonical_address carried by structuredContent — exactly the declared RED negative control, so the mutant is killed by the registered probe and is not vacuous.
runner: tests/contracts/mutation-runner/main.go executes this case from tests/contracts/mutation-registry.json under the GO_UNIT harness for the invariant entry `acceptance.r3a1.mcp.text-channel-carries-addresses`; the identical case is committed both here and in the registry so the proof is pinned to the product guard.
